snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto: Carcer City Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto Carcer City is a fan made total conversion mod for GTA San Andreas, taking you to the American heartland - home to the decaying streets of Carcer City into the biggest and most detailed 3D era Grand Theft Auto city yet.

Set in 2001, the mod features a brand new storyline following an ex police officer dragged into Carcer City’s criminal underworld, where industry is collapsing, institutions are failing, gangs are taking over and survival is never guaranteed.


🎶Welcome (Back) - Land of the Loops🎶

Download the demo: https://www.moddb.com/mods/gta-carcer-city/downloads/gta-carcer-city-demo

Join the Discord Server: https://discord.gg/EM6635dEqz
